title: 1991 AMC 8 Problem 19
statement: The average (arithmetic mean) of \(10\) different positive whole numbers is \(10.\) The largest possible value of any of these numbers is

solutions.text:
The ten numbers sum to \(100.\) To maximize one of them, the other nine (all different positive whole numbers) should be as small as possible: \(1 + 2 + \cdots + 9 = 45.\)

The largest number is then \(100 - 45 = 55.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: The ten numbers must sum to \(10 \times 10 = 100\)
To make one number as large as possible, make the other nine as small as possible: \(1, 2, \ldots, 9\)
